clue.text: Group watched a mechanical cutter

parts.note: a band is a group, of musicians for instance
saw is the past tense of see, meaning watched

explanation.surface: Some people looked on as a machine sliced through something.
explanation.definitionFit: A powered saw with a continuous toothed loop of steel is a machine for cutting wood or metal.

clue.text: Get suit

explanation.surface: A terse instruction to obtain some clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: To get angry is to grow or turn angry; a colour that suits you flatters you, as one that does that is said to do.

clue.text: Can I analyse one new vitamin?

indicators.note: to analyse is to break down and examine, so the letters of the words before it are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A question about whether a lab test could identify a fresh vitamin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'analyse' rearranges CANI into NIAC; the single letters I and N follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Also called nicotinic acid or B3, this compound is one of the B group of vitamins.

clue.text: Egoist trying to find his true identity

definitions.text: trying to find his true identity

explanation.surface: A self-absorbed person on a journey of self-discovery.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes the phrase literally: one who seeks the self.
explanation.definitionFit: An egoist puts personal advantage first; read literally, the phrase describes a person searching for their own self.

clue.text: Now a terrine contains moisture

indicators.note: the three words before it are said to hold the answer within their run of letters

explanation.surface: A remark that a pâté dish is currently holding liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: Moisture is dampness, and the commonest liquid causing dampness is the clear fluid from taps.

clue.text: Bill detests a true friend

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill to be paid
detests means hates

explanation.surface: Someone receiving an invoice loathes a loyal companion.
explanation.walkthrough: Achates is the faithful companion of Aeneas in Virgil's Aeneid, so his name stands for a loyal friend.
explanation.definitionFit: In Virgil's epic, Aeneas's devoted comrade became proverbial for staunch loyalty.

clue.text: Across atop large church in Devon

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second

parts.note: read as two words, a cross: A plus X, the cross-shaped letter
a minster is a large or important church

explanation.surface: Directions to a big cathedral somewhere in south-west England.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'Across' as 'a cross', giving A and X. Axminster is a town in Devon, a county in south-west England, famous for its carpets.
explanation.definitionFit: The town, known for carpet weaving, lies in that south-western English county.

clue.text: Rush to find Burke's accomplice

explanation.surface: Hurrying off to track down a criminal's partner.
explanation.walkthrough: Burke and Hare were notorious murderers in 1820s Edinburgh who sold their victims' bodies for dissection.
explanation.definitionFit: To hare is to run fast; William Hare was the partner of William Burke in the Edinburgh body-snatching murders.

clue.text: Broadcast by Muslim leader en route

indicators.note: here by means within or via, placing the leader inside the travelling word

parts.note: something en route is in transit, on its way

indicators.note: a leader comes at the front, so only the opening letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Something aired by an imam while travelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' takes M from 'Muslim'; that letter goes into TRANSIT, as something 'en route' is in transit.
explanation.definitionFit: To broadcast is to send out a signal, programme or message over the airwaves.

clue.text: In the main there's no accommodation cheaper

definitions.text: In the main there's no accommodation cheaper

parts.words: In the main there's no accommodation cheaper
parts.note: the main is the sea, so this describes the lowest class of passenger berth on an ocean voyage

explanation.surface: A claim that, on the whole, no lodging costs less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the main' looks like 'generally'; it means 'at sea'.
explanation.definitionFit: The cheapest passenger quarters on a ship, originally near the rudder gear.

clue.text: Slow walk fast stroke

explanation.surface: A contrast between dawdling on land and speeding in the pool.
explanation.definitionFit: To move at a snail's pace is to inch along; front crawl is the quickest swimming style.

clue.text: Less savage way employed by Mongolian conqueror

parts.note: tamer means less wild or savage
a lane is a way or narrow road

explanation.surface: A gentler approach adopted by a warlord from the steppes.
explanation.walkthrough: Tamerlane (Timur) was a 14th-century Turco-Mongol conqueror of Central Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Timur the Lame, founder of the Timurid empire, conquered much of Western and Central Asia.

clue.text: Chief motive to find primary source of water

explanation.surface: Someone searching for the main reason, and for where the river begins.
explanation.definitionFit: The driving force behind something is its prime mover; read in two parts, it is the principal well or spring.

clue.text: Disheartened theatre attendant becomes an addict

indicators.note: losing its heart means the middle letter of the word is removed

parts.note: an usher shows people to their seats in a theatre

explanation.surface: A dispirited usher at a playhouse falls into drug habits.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes drugs habitually is a druggie or junkie, a habitual taker.

clue.text: In disagreement about offensive language

parts.note: on can mean about or concerning, as in a book on birds
bad can mean offensive, as in bad language
terms are words or expressions, language

explanation.surface: A complaint concerning swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people who are at odds and unfriendly with each other have fallen out.

clue.text: There are Socialist candidates beaten hollow

parts.note: the left is the socialist side of politics
candidates in an election are those standing for office

explanation.surface: An election report that the left-wing contenders were trounced.
explanation.definitionFit: To be soundly outclassed by a rival who races far ahead is idiomatically to be left behind motionless.

clue.text: Attempt to impound every sovereign constitutes treason

indicators.note: to impound is to shut something up inside, so the attempt word encloses the others

parts.note: a try is an attempt
each means every
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the monarch's cipher

explanation.surface: Seizing all of a ruler's possessions amounts to betraying the crown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to impound' puts EACH and ER inside TRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Betrayal of trust or of one's country is disloyalty, of which treason is the gravest form.

clue.text: Wine for easy transportation

parts.note: suggests a fortified wine from Oporto that is fit to be carried, describing something light enough to carry about

explanation.surface: A bottle meant for taking on a picnic.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue plays on port, the fortified wine, followed by -able: something easily carried.
explanation.definitionFit: Something easily carried or moved, like a radio or computer, is designed to travel.

clue.text: Street warden who is unfamiliar

parts.note: a ranger is a park or forest warden

explanation.surface: A traffic warden that nobody recognises.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone not known to you is an outsider or newcomer.

clue.text: Entreat her to make changes in retirement

indicators.note: the words are made to change their order, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Begging a woman to adjust her life after she stops working.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is ENTREAT HER TO, all twelve letters; 'to make changes' is the anagram signal, though 'to' also belongs to the fodder in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: An army withdrawing is falling back; both phrases describe a backward movement or withdrawal.

clue.text: Make love to an Oscar-winning actor

parts.note: a make is a brand, as of cars
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: An invitation to romance a film star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make' is a noun here, as in a make of car. Marlon Brando won Oscars for On the Waterfront and The Godfather.
explanation.definitionFit: Marlon Brando twice won the Academy Award for Best Actor.

clue.text: Agree to arsenic being dispatched

parts.note: As is the chemical symbol for arsenic
dispatched means sent off

explanation.surface: Consenting to a poison being sent off.
explanation.definitionFit: To assent is to give consent or concur.

clue.text: Bring back some gin

indicators.note: bringing something back turns it round, so the word for some is read in reverse

parts.note: part means some, a portion

explanation.surface: Asking for a little more of the spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gin' is not the drink: a gin is a snare for animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin trap is a snare for catching game, so a gin is a device for catching animals.

clue.text: Text sure to be dissected by theologians

definitions.text: Text sure to be dissected by theologians

parts.note: a script is a written text

indicators.note: cutting the word up lets its letters be reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Theology scholars will certainly pick apart this passage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be dissected' rearranges SURE into URES after SCRIPT; the whole clue also describes what theologians study.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacred writings such as the Bible are the texts theologians study in detail.

clue.text: One wood that is perfect

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
deal is pine or fir timber

explanation.surface: A single plank of timber that is flawless.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawless, matching the best one could imagine, is a model or exemplar.

clue.text: Quiet word of sympathy from the emperor

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
ah is an exclamation of sympathy

explanation.surface: A ruler speaks softly in sympathy.
explanation.walkthrough: The Shah was the monarch of Iran, sometimes styled emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: The title of the former hereditary ruler of Iran, whose full style was King of Kings.

clue.text: VIP gives wide smile for the camera

parts.note: big means large or wide
photographers ask people to say cheese to make them smile

explanation.surface: A celebrity beams broadly for photographers.
explanation.definitionFit: An important, influential person is a bigwig or top dog.

clue.text: Limited space for a large stove

explanation.surface: A small kitchen with room only for one big cooker.
explanation.definitionFit: A range is an area or scope within limits; a range is also a large kitchen cooking stove.

clue.text: Worldly trainee in crude environment

indicators.note: the trainee is placed in the crude word, which surrounds it

parts.note: earthy means coarse or crude
L is for learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A sophisticated apprentice in rough surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts L inside EARTHY; 'environment' is surface dressing for the surrounding word.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthly matters belong to this world rather than heaven: mundane, terrestrial.

clue.text: Carry on giving money to a porter

parts.note: L stands for pound, from Latin libra, a unit of money
porter is a dark beer, much like stout

explanation.surface: Tipping a hotel porter to keep going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'porter' looks like a doorman; it is the dark beer.
explanation.definitionFit: To last out is to endure or survive to the end.
